+"""The EmptyValueError error and its helper."""
+
+try:
+    import tomli  # noqa: F401
+except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
+    tomli = None
+
+from lamina.errors import LaminaError
+
+
+class EmptyValueError(LaminaError):
+    """Raised for empty value problems."""
+
+
+def raise_empty_value(message: str, line: int, column: int, *, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
+    """Raise EmptyValueError for message at line and column."""
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(message)
+    full_message = message if message.endswith(".") else message + "."
+    if line < 1:
+        raise EmptyValueError(full_message, 1, max(column, 1))
+    raise EmptyValueError(full_message, line, column)

+

+        raise_empty_value("bad", 2, 3)
+
+
+def test_empty_value_line_zero():
+    with pytest.raises(EmptyValueError):
